string.text: Are you fucking crazy? Doing this right in front of people?
Why the fuck did you come to the Zone if you can't find a toilet, you dickhead?
Fucking hell, the camera is on, you freak.
Next time I'll shoot you while you're busy with this, you scum.
Decided to shit all over the Zone? You fucking degenerate.
Disgusting, fuck. I'm ashamed of you.
Like a fucking dog. Right in front of everyone, you idiot.
At least step behind a corner, you dumb fuck.
Worm. I'm watching and turning off my conscience. I'll fucking shoot you.
I put your name on my radar. Expect a visit, you bastard.
You won't wash your hands after this — you'll catch an infection, and no one will fucking help you.
Oh, fuck, what a sight for cops and freaks.
I'll teach you to squat. Fast. And painfully. With blood.
You're a fucking complete degenerate, shit.
Is this your first day in the Zone, you fucking stalker? People are around!
I'll roll a grenade under your ass right now, you freak.
A fucking pig. A real one, shit.
Remember my face? I don't — but a bullet? Yes, in the back of your head.
Could've written "move away" on your PDA, you fucking idiot.
Fucking disgrace. I'd fucking shoot you for this.
Go sit in an anomaly, at least no one will see you there, you freak.
Fucking pig. Watch yourself, you filthy freak.
If a mutant smells this — I'll be the first to leave you behind, won't even make a sound.
Are you serious, dickhead? Right next to my backpack?
Too bad I'm wasting bullets on you. Next time I won't hold back.
You fucking piece of shit. Didn't your mother teach you to step into the bushes?
I'm taking a photo for the Duty base. You'll be famous all over the Zone, you goat.
There's a spot behind those rocks. You fucking moron, can't you see?
I've marked you, you fucking clown.
Got gut problems? Have the decency to warn me, you scum.
Fucking disgrace to your faction.
Fuck, I can smell it through the screen, you vermin.
Did your hands fall off? At least step away, you embarrassment.
Next time I'll send you flying with a shot mid-jump, fuck.
The Zone isn't a dump, and you're not a fucking pig, you dumb dickhead.
Fucking freak, seriously. Zero upbringing, fuck.
I became a stalker to watch this, you fuck?!
Marking your territory? Wanted to be a wolf, you idiot?
Done? Now run while I'm still feeling generous. Later I'll kill you.
No shame, no conscience, nothing fucking left.
A blind dog would've been better — at least it would've distracted you and eaten you.
You fucking droid, could've stepped aside, you brainless idiot.
Sit still, don't move. I've already posted the artifact for everyone to see. Let them all watch.
Like livestock. Just like fucking livestock.
A report like this on the PDA — hit of the fucking season, you asshole.
I've got you marked. Now everywhere you go, you'll be "that guy", you scum.
Should I shoot you as a warning? My hand is fucking itching.
Your hands come out of your ass, and you still go there, you fucking degenerate.
Smash your head against the concrete, it'll help. Or you'll die — either works.
That's it, you're blocked. And on my execution list, you bastard.
Doing this in front of people — a fucking disgrace, you freak.
Look, bitch, mutants will come running to the smell now, you idiot.
Did your fucking hands fall off? Couldn't walk further away? I'll fucking kill you.
I remember you, scum. Next time we meet — you'll pick up your teeth piece by piece.
You piece of shit, didn't your mother teach you that this is done in private, you fag?
Done? Now fuck off while I count my bullets. Later it'll be too late.
Fucking embarrassment. You should fucking shoot yourself and get it over with.
Are you serious, dickhead? Right on the grass where people walk, fuck?!
If I see it again — I'll shoot you and say you attacked me. They'll believe it.
You fucking pig. There's enough shit in the Zone already, and you added more.
Think you're alone? The camera on the tower is recording, you fucking degenerate.
Your little performance — even a mutant would turn away, fucking disgusting.
I put your name on my radar. Tomorrow at six — talk on the pipe. Come if you want to live.
You do this in front of everyone — means you'll die in front of everyone, you scum.
You're a fucking idiot, fuck. How can you be this stupid?!
You stink from a kilometer away, and you're still doing this in front of people, scum.
Want me to come over and bury you with my foot like shit? Fresh one.
Even a bloodsucker wouldn't eat that crap. Too good for it.
What the fuck do we need you in the Zone for? You just ruin the air, dickhead.
I've got you marked. Now every Duty member has your mug on the wall.
Felt like doing that — go sit in an anomaly, you'll fucking die there.
Are you out of your fucking mind, dickhead? This isn't a fucking dorm.
You'd do it right on Sidorovich's base too, you fag.
I'd gouge my eyes out after seeing that, you freak.
Scum. If I see your corpse — I'll spit and walk past, won't even look back.
You're finished, I'm serious. Completely finished, you fucking asshole.
Now imagine a chimera watching you. Still funny, you freak?
You're a fucking animal. Literally, fuck.
I'll send your coordinates to every stalker right now. Go ahead, hero, fucking walk around.
Do that business at home. In the Zone, you get killed for this. And I will kill you.
What the fuck, are you completely insane, you dumb fuck?!
Mutants eat people like you first. And they're fucking right to, you scum.
I'll teach you to respect personal space. With blood. Yours.
What, your fucking mouth doesn't work? Couldn't say "move away", you idiot?
Shameless piece of shit. I stole your ammo magazine while you were busy. Good luck finding it.
Hands growing out of your ass — that's literally you, fuck.
Too bad I didn't shoot you right away. I'll fix that soon.
You'd do it right into my campfire, you fucking goat.
You're a fucking museum exhibit. They should put morons like you in a museum.
Watch your surroundings, fag. What if I'm behind you with a knife? Already am.
The whole Zone is your toilet? Sure, you won't last long, scum.
What you did is worse than any emission. Fucking disgusting.
You didn't die from natural needs, but you lost your fucking conscience. And any last shred of shame.
Crushing you like a blind dog — wouldn't feel a thing. Actually, it'd be nice.
I hacked your PDA. Now the whole cluster knows what a freak you are, dickhead.
You pathetic fuck. Can't even step away properly, you idiot.
Next time I'll roll a grenade under your ass. For hygiene. And fun.
You're the reason there are no women in the Zone. And there never fucking will be, shit.
You're a fucking loser. Seriously. A complete loser, you filthy freak.
That's it, I'm leaving. Just don't fucking piss on my boots while I walk past, you asshole.
